0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3, 11th in the East, 2.5 games back in fourth in the Central) host the New York Knicks (0-3, 12th in the East, 2.5 games back in fourth in the Atlantic), with Chicago on a two-game losing streak and New York on three straight losses. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bulls lost 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York in their most recent meeting.
